CLAIM — session_017Qqyix2QcnpUC9XeYVDzx3, branch `claude/issue-4535-export-options-reconcile`. Dispatching a dev agent now.

**PM ruling (delegated decision authority; maintainer veto window open — record objections here):** the card's four items, with the Blocked-by resolved by measurement:

1. **Gate-check FIRST**: measure whether objectui's pinned @objectstack/spec (node_modules / lockfile version) carries the new `ListViewExportOptionsSchema` object form (the #8324 change). The answer splits the card:
   - **Pin carries it** ⇒ all four items land: local type aligned to the five keys (prefer importing/deriving from the spec type over restating it — measure whether the spec type is importable from objectui's types package without a dependency-direction violation; if not importable, restate the five keys and make the alignment comment TRUE by citing the spec symbol), `'pdf'` removed (its warn-drop path dead), `streaming` typed and the `as any` deleted, and item 4's parse-lift confirmation measured (which path feeds ObjectGrid its schema; keep the renderer's array tolerance ONLY if raw un-parsed metadata can still reach it — state which in the PR).
   - **Pin does not carry it** ⇒ land items 1–3 (objectui-local, forward-compatible: the five-key type IS the new spec shape), keep the renderer's array tolerance with the reason stated, and record item 4 as completing when the pin bumps — the card stays open on that residue with a note, PR titled `Part of #4535`.
2. Constraint honored as a TEST: no sixth undeclared-but-read key — a pin asserting the read-key set ⊆ the declared five (the drift-guard pattern), so the defect #8010 closed cannot recreate.
3. Red-first: the `as any` deletion is type-level red (tsc rejects the untyped read pre-change... measure the direction — actually the cast SUPPRESSES the error, so the red is: removing the cast on unfixed types errors verbatim; post-fix compiles). `'pdf'` removal: the warn-path's test (if any) updated as an authorized pin move, declared.
4. Changesets: '@object-ui/types' per its .d.ts (local type narrowing/alignment — if the published type changes shape, grade minor with the reasoning; if byte-compatible, patch); '@object-ui/plugin-grid' patch expected. Never major.

**Mutual exclusion:** ⛔ ObjectGrid.tsx regions owned by landed work (LinkCell #4531, date cells #4544/#4552, kebab) — touch ONLY the exportOptions read region (~:1596–:1642, re-locate by content). packages/types was just touched by #4569 (landed) — base on current main. Disjoint from in-flight #4548 (react+dashboard/report), #4566 (core+DatasetWidget), #4567 (StudioDesignSurface), #4563 (apps/console).

**PM verdict: ACCEPT — parked, review chain owns enqueue. Open question answered: A (keep `Fixes #4535`).** (`session_01PBjwYLS6BciTQW3c9xQiD2`)

Verified on GitHub — PR [#6957](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/pull/6957):

- **The partial premise falsification is the headline and it is a good run**: items 2+3 were already landed on main (changeset `1f9b905`) — my claim's "all four items land in full" was stale, the dev measured instead of re-implementing. What was live: item 1's alignment comment had gone false a SECOND time (stale rc.6 pin note vs installed 17.2.0), and item 4 was unanswered.
- **The fix is the right class**: prose alignment replaced by a mechanical parity test that reads the INSTALLED spec at test time (key set, enum, upstream strictness, 'pdf' refusal prescription, array lift, non-vacuity floor), with the local key set projected through an exhaustive mapped type so local drift fails to compile — a comment that went false twice is not the instrument to trust a third time.
- **Item 4 answered by three measurements**: raw un-parsed metadata DOES reach the renderer (no parse on the render path; `normalizeListViewSchema` never touches `exportOptions`; `ObjectView.tsx:2116` forwards verbatim) ⇒ the plugin-list tolerance is load-bearing and stays; ObjectGrid's silent bare-array degradation recorded on the follow-up, not changed in passing.
- **Stop-on-breach honored**: the unlanded ListView leg (zod mirror still 'pdf'-bearing/non-strict, plugin-list `as any` reads) sits outside the declared surface — measured and filed as #6956 with re-check commands instead of fixed. Left ungraded for triage (contract-face routing is triage's call).
- **Form**: draft ✓ · `needs:contract-review` both carriers read back ✓ · 3 files ✓ · ObjectGrid untouched (fenced regions never opened) ✓ · changeset `@object-ui/types` patch with the named precedent and the reasoned distinction from `1f9b905`'s minor ✓ · ablation direction substitution declared honestly (the dispatched direction no longer existed; the substituted one is what the new guard actually protects) ✓.
- **Answer A adopted**: the card enumerates its files and its four items are satisfied or measured on them; #6956 carries the remaining leg with full evidence. Nothing is lost by closing this card at landing.

Platform fact from this run, carried to the shift handover: the GitHub body sanitizer eats `<` followed by a letter (tag-shaped fragments) in issue/PR bodies; `<` followed by a space or quote survives — measured on both this PR body and #6956, repaired with spaced spellings.

Note for the landing window: `mergeable_state` is *behind*; bring the base in at release time.
